title: Skills and permission rules work from the PowerShell tool
goal: The read-only kb commands allowed for the Bash tool in .claude/settings.json are allowed for the PowerShell tool too, in the rule form the kb documents; no skill runs a command in a form only a POSIX shell parses (an environment prefix such as GIT_EDITOR=true or KB_VERIFIED=, or curl, which Windows PowerShell 5.1 maps to Invoke-WebRequest).
notes: On Windows Claude Code routes shell commands through the PowerShell tool where it is enabled (claude/hooks.md:71, DOC S743), and .claude/settings.json allows only Bash(python3 ...) rules, so the same read-only commands prompt there.
